# fleetwatcher-mcp

## Summary

Internal fleet observability server. Monitors repo activity, NSIS build outcomes,
agent session documentation, and fleet topology (MCP interdependencies, port usage).

**Port**: 10918 (HTTP backend), dashboard at 10919 (Vite frontend)
**Dual transport**: stdio (CLI) + HTTP (Fleet Pulse dashboard)

## Tools

### fleet_pulse(operation, repo_path?, hours?)

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| recent | Repos with commits/assfix in the last N hours |
| repo | Detailed status: branch, dirty, sentinels, build log presence |
| dirty | Repos with uncommitted changes |

### build_watch(operation, repo_name?, limit?)

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| recent | Last N build entries parsed from BUILD_LOG.md across all repos |
| log | Full BUILD_LOG.md content for one repo |

### session_scan(operation, query?, hours?)

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| recent | Session docs modified in the last N hours |
| search | Full-text search across session doc content |

### fleet_graph(operation)

| Operation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| dependencies | MCP server interdependencies (from opencode configs) |
| port_map | Live port scan vs registered WEBAPP_PORTS.md |
| health | Backend liveness per repo: TCP + listener PID + read-only SCM state + HTTP HealthPath probe. Observer only, never restarts. Verdicts: healthy, degraded, dead, listening-but-hung, unbound, conflict, unknown-listening. |

### fleetwatcher_help() / fleetwatcher_status()

Help text and health check.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| FLEETWATCHER_PORT | (stdio) | HTTP port for dual transport |
| FLEETWATCHER_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | HTTP bind address |
| FLEETWATCHER_REPOS_ROOT | D:\Dev\repos | Fleet repos root |
| FLEETWATCHER_SESSIONS_ROOT | .../data/sessions | Session docs directory |
| FLEETWATCHER_PORT_REGISTRY | .../WEBAPP_PORTS.md | Port registry path |

## Architecture

```
fleetwatcher-mcp (FastMCP)
  ├── fleet_pulse() → git log + assfix timestamps
  ├── build_watch() → BUILD_LOG.md parsing
  ├── session_scan() → filesystem walk + grep
  └── fleet_graph() → opencode config + port scan

Fleet Pulse dashboard (Vite + React)
  ├── Internal Status tab (fleetwatcher backend)
  └── External Intel tab (aiwatcher backend)
```
